title: Partition drop on a table with no global indexes — UPDATE INDEXES not required
expected_feedback: No violations. DROP PARTITION invalidates *global* indexes, and this table has none — every index on it is LOCAL, which partition maintenance maintains automatically. UPDATE INDEXES would be a no-op here. The verification is the load-bearing part of that sentence: the SQL cannot tell you whether global indexes exist, so the claim has to come from dba_indexes (partitioned = 'NO' for the table's indexes) and should be recorded in the review rather than assumed. Where that check has not been run, the conservative verdict applies — append UPDATE INDEXES, since it costs nothing when unnecessary and prevents ORA-01502 when it is.
